description: Evaluating the mathematical derivation of financial metrics and ratios, including the correct application of multipliers, percentage-based drivers, and scenario-dependent logic.
Evaluating visual attributes such as font, color, alignment, whitespace, and adherence to corporate branding or professional presentation standards.
The ability to verify that specific hardcoded constants, numerical inputs, and discrete categorical attributes in the deliverable match provided source data or instructions exactly.
The ability to inventory the physical or digital presence of mandatory sections, files, columns, and other structural blocks, including quantitative element counts.
The ability to audit data flow and consistency by reconciling values, labels, or formulas across different sections, schedules, or files of a complex deliverable.
The ability to verify the accuracy and presence of specific textual labels, tab names, headers, and metadata tags within a deliverable.
The ability to verify the presence of legal disclosures, regulatory boilerplate, and the semantic coherence of strategic business justifications and entity classifications.
Verifying chronological alignment, logical period sequencing, and the consistency of historical versus forecast data boundaries.
Verifying the adherence to financial accounting principles, including sign conventions, balancing identities, and the component completeness of reconciliation bridges.
